claims.quote: KCNB1 encodes an α-subunit of the delayed-rectifier voltage-dependent potassium channel Kv2.1.
De novo pathogenic variants of KCNB1 have been linked to developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs)
Loss of function (LOF) of KCNB1 has been proposed as the pathogenic mechanism in these disorders.
a knockout zebrafish line targeting kcnb1 (kcnb1+/- and kcnb1-/-)

claims.object_text: expressed in neurons, oligodendrocytes, and microglial cells
claims.quote: In wild-type (WT) larval zebrafish, kcnb1 was found in various regions of the central nervous system and in diverse cell subtypes including neurons, oligodendrocytes, and microglial cells.

claims.object_text: impaired swimming behavior and epilepsy-like features
claims.quote: Both kcnb1+/- and kcnb1-/- zebrafish displayed impaired swimming behavior and "epilepsy-like" features

claims.object_text: rescue by human Kv2.1 WT DNA
claims.quote: which was restored by the human Kv2.1 WT DNA.

claims.object_text: elevated locomotor activity after PTZ exposure
claims.quote: When exposed to the chemoconvulsant pentylenetetrazol (PTZ), both knockout models showed elevated locomotor activity.

claims.object_text: increased bdnf mRNA expression and higher c-Fos fluorescence intensity
claims.quote: PTZ-exposed kcnb1-/- larvae exhibited increased bdnf mRNA expression and higher c-Fos fluorescence intensity in cells of the telencephalon.

claims.object_text: spontaneous and provoked epileptiform-like electrographic activity
claims.quote: presents spontaneous and provoked epileptiform-like electrographic activity

claims.object_text: brain anatomy and neuronal circuit organization remained unaffected
